findings.title: Segment-aware address discovery requirement has no mechanism, owner, or meaningful test coverage
findings.evidence: FIXED at d8d53364: Complete Segment Invariants now names the owner ('The owner is the existing RBG discovery ConfigMap builder; no separate Segment discovery component is introduced'), decides the enumeration source ('the committed base target — RBG role replicas before a child exists, otherwise the child RIS committed ordinals — and never from live Pods or RoleInstances'), and rules out surge identities by construction. Harness check_f1_discovery.sh (a) mechanism/owner and (b) integration+e2e coverage now PASS on head (results/r2-reverify.txt); round-1 results/f1-discovery.txt recorded both FAIL at bd378ebd. Code claims verified: CommittedOrdinals() reads desired membership from spec.replicas + committed-skip annotation, independent of live instances (api/workloads/v1alpha2/excluded_ordinals.go:112, canary TestVerifyKEP543_CommittedOrdinalsAreSpecBased); memberOrdinals already routes annotated paths to set.CommittedOrdinals() with the comment 'Discovery follows the committed child target, not live Pods' (pkg/discovery/config_builder.go:240-285); surge ordinals >= spec.replicas by construction (topology.surgeStart == replicas, materializeSurge allocates forward from the last base ordinal, stateful_instance_set_utils.go:261,429-451, canary TestVerifyKEP543_SurgeOrdinalsAtOrAboveReplicas). Ratio validation now explicitly runs 'at the start of RBG reconciliation, before the discovery ConfigMap ... is updated', so the misaligned window retains the last aligned table. Test plan gained an 'Address Discovery' integration subsection (2 bullets) and an e2e bullet.

findings.title: Fail-fast inversion left the per-rule isolation sentence stale: 'Non-Segment Stateless roles are unaffected' now contradicts whole-RBG halt
findings.evidence: Commit 80e8897a ('make segment validation fail-fast') inverted the round-1 blocking semantics: sparse membership and invalid member-mode combinations now 'stop the entire RBG reconciliation' (README.md L378/L379, ZH L378/379) and a ratio violation 'stops the RBG reconciliation before any target or group description is written' (L388, L394). But the neighboring bullet still says 'Non-Segment Stateless roles are unaffected' (EN L382, ZH L380 '非 Segment 的 Stateless role 不受该限制影响') — under fail-fast this is stale: a non-Segment Stateless role in the same RBG IS affected at the reconciliation level (its target writes, parameter updates, and discovery ConfigMap updates freeze while the invalid Segment configuration persists); only its running instances are unaffected (L1224 integration bullet covers running, not reconciling). Differential evidence: check_r2_consistency.sh PASS on bd378ebd (per-rule semantics, 'unaffected' true) / FAIL on d8d53364 (fail-fast + stale sentence); bites check green under a simulated reword (results/r2-contract-checks.txt). The doc also never states the blast-radius consequence that one invalid Segment rule freezes RBG-level reconciliation for all roles in the RBG — worth one sentence stating the intended scope.
findings.proposedFix: Reword the L382/L380 bullet (e.g. 'Non-Segment Stateless roles are exempt from the membership requirement, but fail-fast halts their RBG-level reconciliation too; only their running instances are unaffected') and add one sentence to the fail-fast paragraphs stating that a persistent violation freezes target/parameter/discovery updates for the entire RBG, including non-Segment roles.

findings.title: [observation, not a defect] B-F1 (Codex round-1 major) fixed and independently verified
findings.evidence: The round-2 redesign resolves both horns of B-F1: B=0 is now valid only with positive effective maxSurge; admission rejects an explicit maxUnavailable: 0 with omitted/zero maxSurge; reconciliation reports percentage budgets that round down to zero without surge (starvation horn); and the new alignment paragraph explicitly acknowledges the RIS floor instead of disclaiming changes to it. Code verification: computeMaxUnavailable applies 'if maxSurge == 0 && raw < 1 { raw = 1 }' in both the default and explicit branches and leaves an explicit 0 untouched when maxSurge > 0 (stateful_instance_set_utils.go:295-328) — canary TestVerifyKEP543_ExplicitZeroFloorsToOneOnlyWithoutSurge pins all four combinations (results/kep543-canary.log). check_b1_zero_budget.sh verifies the redesign text is present in EN+ZH (results/r2-contract-checks.txt); the same check fails on bd378ebd (control). Segment-mode surge projection uses ceil() at the Segment layer, so a positive percentage always resolves to >= 1 group — no residual round-to-zero-surge hole.
